description: Use parser-safe route words for bounded House hauling and recover only explicitly authored remote Mara request targets from NOT-HERE noun state.

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) WEST = V-R1277-HAUL-WEST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) EAST = V-R1277-HAUL-EAST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) UP = V-R1277-HAUL-UP>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) DOWN = V-R1277-HAUL-DOWN>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) OUT = V-R1277-HAUL-OUT>
<SYNONYM HAUL DRAG>
replacements.new:
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) WESTWARD = V-R1277-HAUL-WEST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) EASTWARD = V-R1277-HAUL-EAST>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) UPSTAIRS = V-R1277-HAUL-UP>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) DOWNSTAIRS = V-R1277-HAUL-DOWN>
<SYNTAX HAUL OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) OUTSIDE = V-R1277-HAUL-OUT>
<SYNONYM HAUL DRAG>

replacements.old: HAUL it one real House route at a time -- for example, HAUL " D ,PRSO " WEST -- and the route itself decides whether it fits.
replacements.new: HAUL it one real House route at a time -- for example, HAUL " D ,PRSO " WESTWARD -- and the route itself decides whether it fits.
